tools.name: get_zorb_visit_options
tools.description: Provides structured information about ZORB Rotorua ride options, booking actions, location, and visitor planning.

visitor_type.description: Type of visitor, such as family, couple, group, corporate, school, tourist, local, or thrill seeker.

goal.description: What the visitor wants help with, such as choosing a ride, booking, planning a visit, venue hire, or finding contact details.

tools.name: open_zorb_booking
tools.description: Opens the ZORB Rotorua booking page for the user. This does not complete a booking or payment.

reason.description: Why the user wants to open the booking page.
